title: pan close still deletes state.json/sessions.json — close-out.ts step 5 never moved to pruneAgentStateDir (PAN-3950 AC-1 unmet)
body:
**PRD:** [.pan/drafts/pan-3950.md](https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/blob/main/.pan/drafts/pan-3950.md) (AC-1, W1) — follow-up to #3950 / PR #3951.

## What happened

Merged `1446555` (PR #3951) and ran `pan close PAN-3950` on the reloaded build (`3760a5d`). Teardown printed `Pruned 4 agent directories (transcripts and state kept)`, but afterwards `~/.overdeck/agents/agent-pan-3950/` contains only `activity.jsonl` — `state.json` and `sessions.json` are gone — and `GET /api/agents/agent-pan-3950/conversation` returns `No transcript found` with `checked: []`. Before close-out the same route returned 108 messages / 315 work-log entries.

This is the original PAN-3705 symptom, reproduced on the issue that was supposed to fix it. **AC-1 of PAN-3950 is unmet on main.**

## Cause

Two teardown paths prune agent state; PR #3951 migrated only one.

- `src/lib/close-out.ts` step 5 ("Clean up agent state") still calls the old `removeAgentStateDir(agentDir)` / `removeAgentStateDir(planningDir)`. That function (`src/lib/agents/state-dir-removal.ts`, `cleanDirectory`) unlinks every non-`.jsonl` file, so `state.json` and `sessions.json` are deleted and only `activity.jsonl` survives. Its step message still says "transcript files preserved".
- The lifecycle teardown (`lifecycle-*.js` / `removeAgentStateDirs`) was switched to the new `pruneAgentStateDir` (deletes only `pending.lock`, `*.sock`, `codex-home*/` except `sessions/`) and prints the new "transcripts and state kept" line — which is why the close-out output looks correct while the direct step-5 call has already removed the files.

Other remaining `removeAgentStateDir` callers look like intentional wipes and are out of scope unless someone decides otherwise: `src/lib/agents/agent-state.ts:86` (deep-wipe), `src/lib/agents/queries.ts:131` (drop non-role rows), `src/lib/agents/removal.ts:22` (`removeAgent`), `src/lib/cloister/agent-gc.ts:214`.

## Fix

1. `src/lib/close-out.ts` step 5: call `pruneAgentStateDir` for `agent-<id>` and `planning-<id>` (and specialist dirs if this step is meant to cover them), and change the step message to the "transcripts and state kept" wording. Remove the `preservedTranscripts` count.
2. Regression test: run the close-out step against a fixture agent dir containing `state.json`, `sessions.json`, `activity.jsonl`, `pending.lock`; assert the first three survive and the lock is gone.
3. Re-verify AC-1 live: `pan close` a fixture issue, then `ls ~/.overdeck/agents/agent-<id>/` shows `state.json` and `sessions.json`, and `/api/agents/agent-<id>/conversation` still resolves.

## Already-pruned agents

`agent-pan-3705` (closed 2026-09-19, pre-fix) and now `agent-pan-3950` have no `sessions.json`; their Claude JSONLs still exist under `~/.claude/projects/-home-eltmon-Projects-overdeck-workspaces-feature-pan-<id>/`. Round 3 deliberately removed the "freshest Claude file in the workspace dir" guess, so these will not resolve until either PAN-3959 (record the transcript path in the index at session start) ships with a backfill, or an operator-run one-off appends the known session ids to `sessions.json`. Decide which in this issue or in #3959.

## Acceptance

- After `pan close <fixture>` on a build containing the fix: `state.json` and `sessions.json` exist in `agent-<fixture>/` and the agent transcript route still returns messages.
- `grep -n removeAgentStateDir src/lib/close-out.ts` prints nothing.
